title: Nachhaltigkeitsberichtsgesetz (NaBeG), BGBl. I Nr. 6/2026 (full title begins: Bundesgesetz, mit dem ein Drittlandunternehmen-Berichterstattungsgesetz erlassen wird)
citation: BGBl. I Nr. 6/2026, ausgegeben am 18. Februar 2026 (NR: GP XXVIII RV 300 AB 386; CELEX 32022L2464)
evidence: Artikel 1, Drittlandunternehmen-Berichterstattungsgesetz § 11 Abs. 1: "Dieses Bundesgesetz tritt mit Ablauf des Tages der Kundmachung im Bundesgesetzblatt in Kraft und ist auf Geschäftsjahre anzuwenden, die am oder nach dem 1. Jänner 2028 beginnen." Artikel 2, UGB § 908 Abs. 7: "§ 221 Abs. 3 und 5 in der Fassung des Nachhaltigkeitsberichtsgesetzes tritt mit Ablauf des Tages der Kundmachung im Bundesgesetzblatt in Kraft." The BGBl. is issued on 18 February 2026 ("Ausgegeben am 18. Februar 2026"), so the day after is 2026-02-19; RIS shows Inkrafttretensdatum 19.02.2026 on UGB § 243b (NOR40275543). Opened https://ogd.ris.bka.gv.at/Dokumente/BgblAuth/BGBLA_2026_I_6/BGBLA_2026_I_6.xml on 2026-11-02.
notes: The brief and the earlier register row asked whether the CSRD transposition is in the Bundesgesetzblatt: it is, BGBl. I Nr. 6/2026, so it is stored, not an F7 row. It is an amending act: Artikel 1 is the new Drittlandunternehmen-Berichterstattungsgesetz (at-dribeg), Artikel 2 to 21 amend the UGB (see at-ugb-243b-267a), AktG, GmbHG, GenG, GenRevG 1997, SE-Gesetz, SCE-Gesetz, ArbVG, WTBG 2017, RPflG, GGG, CBCR-VeröffG, APAG, AIFMG, BWG, BörseG 2018, InvFG 2011, NBG 1984, SpG and VAG 2016. The one record is the whole authentic BGBl. text (about 310,000 characters) in German, the only official language. Application dates of the UGB changes are in UGB § 908 (financial years from 2024-01-01 with exceptions). No English translation of the BGBl. exists: the RIS Englische-Rv list (OGD application Erv, 136 documents on 2026-11-02) has none. Any EU omnibus changes after the Act are not part of it.

title: Nachhaltigkeits- und Diversitätsverbesserungsgesetz (NaDiVeG), BGBl. I Nr. 20/2017
citation: BGBl. I Nr. 20/2017, ausgegeben am 17. Jänner 2017 (NR: GP XXV RV 1355 AB 1406; CELEX 32014L0095)
evidence: Artikel 1, UGB § 906 Abs. 44 as inserted: "... § 243b, § 243c, § 243d, § 244, § 267a, § 267b, § 267c, ... in der Fassung des Bundesgesetzes BGBl. I Nr. 20/2017 treten mit 6. Dezember 2016 in Kraft. Sie sind erstmalig auf Unterlagen der Rechnungslegung für Geschäftsjahre anzuwenden, die nach dem 31. Dezember 2016 beginnen." Artikel 2 (AktG § 262 Abs. 37) and Artikel 3 (GmbHG § 127 Abs. 21) say the same date. Opened https://ogd.ris.bka.gv.at/Dokumente/BgblAuth/BGBLA_2017_I_20/BGBLA_2017_I_20.xml on 2026-11-02.
notes: Added to the brief candidates: the UGB sections (at-ugb-243b-267a) are the text, this is the Act that inserted them. The act amends the UGB, the AktG and the GmbHG; the whole BGBl. text is the one record. German only (the BGBl. has one language, and the RIS Erv list has no entry). The Act is dated 2017 but takes effect on 2016-12-06, before its own promulgation, as its text says.

title: Bundesgesetz gegen den unlauteren Wettbewerb 1984 (UWG), §§ 1 to 2a: unfair, aggressive and misleading commercial practices, comparative advertising
citation: UWG, BGBl. Nr. 448/1984, §§ 1, 1a, 2 and 2a as amended (most recently BGBl. I Nr. 58/2026, CELEX 32024L0825); RIS Gesetzesnummer 10002665
evidence: RIS Bundesrecht konsolidiert shows Inkrafttretensdatum 23.11.1984 on § 1 of StF BGBl. Nr. 448/1984 (NOR12033573). The original commencement clause is not in any file stored. Opened the OGD-RIS BrKons listing https://data.bka.gv.at/ris/api/v2.6/Bundesrecht?Applikation=BrKons&Gesetzesnummer=10002665&Abschnitt.Typ=Paragraph&Abschnitt.Von=1&Abschnitt.Bis=2a on 2026-11-02.
notes: Records: nine German consolidations of §§ 1, 1a, 2 and 2a (1984-11-23, 1988-07-30, 2000-04-01, 2007-12-12, 2015-04-23, 2016-12-31, 2022-07-20, 2026-07-29, 2026-09-27) and one English translation record (2022-07-20). Directive (EU) 2024/825 (empowering consumers for the green transition) is in the version of 2026-09-27 (BGBl. I Nr. 58/2026): new § 1 Abs. 4 Z 11 to 17 add definitions (among them Umweltaussage, allgemeine Umweltaussage, Nachhaltigkeitssiegel and Zertifizierungssystem), and § 2 Abs. 3 Z 4 treats an environmental claim about future performance without a verifiable implementation plan as misleading. The blacklist in the Anhang (Z 1 to 23j and 24 to 31a), where the green-claim bans sit, is outside §§ 1 to 2a and is not stored. English: the Federal Chancellery translation in RIS (ERV_1984_448) is a two-column German and English table of the whole Act. Its English column states "as of: 20 July 2022 pursuant to Federal Law Gazette I no. 110/2022" and, as the amendment entailing its latest update, BGBl. I Nr. 99/2023, with the German column updated to Fassung 27.9.2026. The 2022-07-20 German version of §§ 1 to 2a is the one that translation matches (ranking, online marketplace and consumer-review rules are in it, none of the 2026 text is), so the English is stored under 2022-07-20. The API metadata of the document says "date of the version: 1 April 2026", which is not what the document says; the document was used. No English exists for the 2026-07-29 and 2026-09-27 versions, and the older German versions have no English. The English column is unofficial: it has [bracketed] editorial insertions and typos (for example "advantage; advantage;" in § 2 Abs. 1 Z 4) kept as printed.
